Organizations such as L’Oréal must include the following information in the records of processing activities required by GDPR Article 30:

1. The purposes of the processing.
2. A description of the categories of data subjects and of the categories of personal data.
3. A detailed description of all the processing done.
4. The envisaged time limits for erasure of the different categories of data.
5. A general description of the technical and organisational security measures.
